parsed.why: Strong legal gender recognition by self-determination, anti-discrimination covering gender expression, hate-crime aggravation, marriage open. Offsets: no ban on visitor-facing restrictions, but prison protocol and emblematic anti-trans killings and violence; institutions litigated. Reduced risk, not top tier due to violence record and weak incitement law.

Prison placement by birth sex with documented sexual assault of trans women; official exclusion of trans women from femicide protection; no hate-crime protection; official tolerance of bias crimes; documented conversion practices; no legal gender recognition and document mismatch exposing visitors at identity checks. Severe tier.

Anti-discrimination law covering gender identity, hate-crime penalties, and court-based gender marker change. Weak implementation, marker change only case-by-case, birth-sex-dependent documents for many. Visible Pride and organising; hostile political speech. Elevated band, leaning reduced given protections.

Legal gender change explicitly banned since 2020; passports and IDs cannot reflect acquired gender, so visitors carry mismatched documents to every screening. Official hostility, child-protection and adoption bans. Recent court rulings and political shift are not yet operative change.

Police use of morality law to arrest and harass trans women, documented police rape and extortion, birth-sex men's prison placement with sexual violence and official inaction, and recorded killings. Impunity documented; no gender-identity protections; anti-discrimination articles exist but enforcement weak. High-severity tier.
